A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ESamp research and contain readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–E. All 25 pages were compared; the appendices are unchanged.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendices C–E report original benchmark evaluations, diversity measurements, ablations, multi-seed results, and throughput experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains the original empirical results, including benchmark performance in Figure 3, multi-seed measurements in Table 12, and throughput measurements in Tables 3 and 20.

M1.justification: The latent distiller, online training loss, novelty-based logit fusion, shared exploration mechanism, and asynchronous procedure remain unchanged in Sections 3–4 and the appendices.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same mathematics, science, coding, and creative-writing coverage using AIME24/25, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench v5, and BookCorpus. No dataset or task scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator participation is unchanged in the main and appendix experiments. OverRIDE remains the same comparator; changing its citation from Anonymous (2025) to Shi and Pan (2026) does not introduce a new method.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 changes GPT-OSS-20B's stated configuration from low thinking effort to medium thinking effort. This is a localized reported protocol revision; the unchanged results do not establish that experiments were rerun. Other evaluation settings are retained.

E4.justification: The sensitivity, decoding-dynamics, noise, vocabulary-space, architecture, sharing, and composability analyses are retained. Appendix C and the case study in Appendix E.6 contain no additions or revisions.

E5.justification: Appendix C.5 and Table 12 retain the same three seeds, 41, 42, and 43, and the same mean-and-standard-deviation reporting. No statistical or uncertainty-reporting procedure changes.

E6.justification: The plotted results, numerical table entries, and reported findings are unchanged. Table 1 retains mathematical Vendi scores of 0.46 for ESamp and 0.32 for Vanilla; only the direction arrow is corrected, consistent with the existing discussion.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation and Appendix A are unchanged, including the KL-regularized policy derivation, vanishing-redundancy definition, Proposition A.2 and its proof, and Assumptions A.3–A.4.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about semantic exploration, Pass@k efficiency, cross-domain effectiveness, diversity and coherence, and low computational overhead.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations, result interpretations, trade-offs, and applicability qualifications are unchanged. The added Impact Statement is generic and provides no substantive new limitation or interpretation.

D1.justification: The low-to-medium thinking-effort revision changes a documented configuration needed to reproduce the GPT-OSS-20B evaluations. Implementation details, distiller hyperparameters, hardware, prompts, and code-access information otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The Anonymous (2025) reference becomes Shi and Pan (2026), retaining the same title and OpenReview identifier. This updates bibliographic metadata; the cited work and ESamp's positioning relative to OverRIDE remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds acknowledgements and a generic Impact Statement, replaces the preprint notice with conference-proceedings information, and updates OverRIDE attribution. The scientific narrative and organization otherwise remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 1 changes the mathematical Vendi header from a downward to an upward arrow. Publication and reference updates produce limited page reflow; figures, table structures, and appendix layouts are retained.

improvement.justification: Correcting Table 1's Vendi arrow removes a misleading indicator and aligns the display with the existing higher-diversity interpretation. Updated attribution provides a further small presentation benefit. Scientific evidence and appendices are unchanged; the unexplained thinking-effort revision does not establish improved experiments or performance.
